essence: One should treat an enemy as friendly everywhere and in other cases.
One should avoid such a mantra that does not cause destruction.
Siddha and others should not be purified at all in woman-given or dream-obtained cases.
Siddha and others should not be purified at all in garland-mantras.
Siddha and others should not be purified at all for sapiṇḍa-letter-mantras.
